name: tokyo-night
description: A clean Visual Studio Code theme that celebrates the lights of Downtown Tokyo at night.
readme:
# Tokyo Night

Color themes inspired by the lights of Downtown Tokyo at night: **Tokyo Night**, Tokyo Night Storm and Tokyo Night Light. After installing, reload the window and pick a theme with `Preferences: Color Theme` (Ctrl+K Ctrl+T), or set `"workbench.colorTheme": "Tokyo Night"` in settings.json.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
